rows.45:3484:
There was no need to go as far as killing the children...
Is that what you're thinking?
{a}, are you a bully?
Or are you the one who gets bullied?
Or maybe you're the type who does nothing and just watches in silence?
Not that it matters.
...But remember this much.
When you commit a sin, you won't necessarily be the one who pays for it.
Through something you'd never expect, someone may be made to atone for the sin you committed.
And when that happens, it'll be too late for regrets.
You're a good person.
...So live a life without regrets, okay?
I thought about taking you with me too, but I decided not to.
I wanted you to play with me, but I've decided to give that up.
Goodbye, {a}.
You probably think I'm a bad girl, but I was bitter too, you know.
I was sad.
Bullies just can't understand how the bullied feel.
I listened to her in silence.
She sighed again.
But it wasn't full of sorrow like before. It was a crisp, clean sigh, as if she were making up her mind once and for all.{p}
rows.45:59e8:
...I didn't lay a hand on the ones who drove me to my death.
Instead, I thought I'd be saved by driving their children to their deaths.
I felt that doing so would wash my ugly, twisted heart clean.
Is that cruel?
...Do you think I'm cruel?
Heh heh heh, think whatever you like.
...But remember this much.
When you commit a sin, you won't necessarily be the one who pays for it.
Through something you'd never expect, someone may be made to atone for the sin you committed.
And when that happens, it'll be too late for regrets.
But it doesn't matter anymore.
None of it...
I've achieved my goal, but I don't think I need to be saved anymore.
...I never thought that even in this state, a heart just like a human's would grow in me.
Just as those children came to enjoy bullying.
And just as it became a habit for them.
I've come to enjoy plunging people into the depths of terror.
Yes, you can find pleasure in anything at all.
It's a real problem, isn't it?
So I've decided to go on like this, chasing nothing but my own pleasure in this school.
Don't worry.
I won't do anything to you.
You're a good person.
I can tell...{p}
rows.45:309c:
That girl was me.
...Ah.
Akemi Iwashita just killed herself.
Heh heh heh... Serves her right.
She slit her own throat with a box cutter in her own room.
...What a stupid woman.
She killed herself because she was tormented by an evil spirit that doesn't even exist.
...Oh, but maybe I'm the evil spirit.
Hee hee... But you know, I can't pass on unless I get my revenge.
...Do you understand now?
The six who told you scary stories are the children of the six who drove me to suicide.
When I killed myself, my father and mother were heartbroken.
But neither those six nor their parents did anything for us.
They said their children weren't the ones to blame.
You see, the six from back then have grown up and become parents like anyone else.
It's no coincidence that their children all ended up coming to this school together.
It's fate.
They were fated from the very start to be killed by me.
You just happened to serve as their guide along the way.
...All six of them are dead.
Their parents, the six who drove me to my death, will surely grieve.
Just as my father and mother grieved.
{a}.
Do you think what I did was horrible?
Do you think their children weren't to blame?{p}
rows.45:4bf4:
She had no face.
Or rather, my face was there.
It was me, talking to me.
"...Liar...
It can't be five...
You're lying...
Are you making fun of me?
That's cruel, so cruel☆"
...Even the way I talk and my voice were exactly the same.{p}
rows.45:6838:
I see.
So that's what you think, {a}...
She said it sadly.
...But you know, {a}.
I think I have been saved.
Whether someone has been saved is for that person to decide.
If I think I've been saved, then I'm saved, no matter what anyone else thinks.
That's just how it is...
"............"
She was right.
Whether she had been saved was for her alone to decide.
No matter what anyone else thought, if she believed she had been saved, then she had been.
She gently put her hand to her mask.
The mask slowly peeled away, revealing the face hidden beneath.{p}
